items.text: Patch 19 is now live - find full patch notes below. Thank you for your continued support and feedback.
Monster Improvements & Additions
New ambush monsters that attack players in the field and dungeons around Hillsbrad Castle in Chapter 2 have been added.
New ambush monsters that attack players in the field and dungeons across Chapter 3 have been added.
Overhauled the overall in-game item reward system.
Rebalanced all item types and quantities across fields, dungeons, caves, and event dungeons in Chapters 1–3 to ensure exploration rewards reflect players' achievements.
When acquiring regular items (non-treasure chests), players can now obtain a wider variety of Low-Grade Enhancement Materials, Buff Items, Recovery Items, and Gold.
Event Reward Adjustments & Enhancements
Event completion rewards have been adjusted and enhanced.
Boss rewards have been updated.
Drop rewards for normal and elite monsters per chapter have been adjusted.
Field Improvements & Exploration Enhancements
Added the 'Puzzle' exploration feature to fields.

Polishing work has been conducted to improve terrain, base locations, player routes, and path visibility in certain areas, resulting in minor terrain adjustments.

Increased the amount of Relic Energy obtained from Memory of the Ancients. Additionally, to provide a greater sense of exploration achievement, the spawn frequency of Memory of the Ancients in the world has been reduced.
The reward amount has also been increased from 600 to 1,000.
Gameplay & Combat Improvements
Added a forced hit reaction option to player skills.
Adjusted Ultimate Skill damage for each weapon type.
Improved game controls.
Removed the feature where movement speed varied based on gamepad analog stick tilt.
Movement speed is now identical between keyboard and gamepad controls.
Adjusted the fee paid to Buff NPCs to 200 Gold.
Merchants selling enhancement materials now sell unified enhancement materials.
Growth System Improvements
Adjusted material requirements for Weapon and Relic enhancements as follows:
\[Weapon Enhancement Materials]
+1 Enhancement: Forgotten Relic Fragment ×25 + Shard of Erosion ×5
+2 Enhancement: Broken Ancient Glyph ×40 + Core of Ruin ×8
+3 Enhancement: Fragment of a Secret Tablet ×60 + Remnant of Oblivion ×12
[p align="start"]\[Relic Enhancement Materials]
[p align="start"]Awakening Stage: Forgotten Relic Fragment ×20 + Shard of Erosion ×4 + 600 Gold
[p align="start"]Radiance Stage: Broken Ancient Glyph ×35 + Core of Ruin ×6 + 1,200 Gold

UI Improvements & Enhancements
Enhanced the Map System.
Added a map legend for easier identification of map symbols.
Players can now place up to 5 custom markers on the map.
Puzzle locations are now displayed on the map.
Dialogue UI now allows seamless gameplay during conversations.
The Map and Inventory can now be opened while the Dialogue UI is displayed.
Players can interact with Field Pages and Spawn Points during dialogue.
Note: Interacting with another NPC during a conversation will immediately cancel the active dialogue.
Town NPCs no longer trigger dialogue automatically upon approach; players must now manually interact with them to trigger dialogue.

The Unburied Cemetery
The Archive of Silence

The Tower of Oblivion

Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where the count for World Logs / Events in the Exploration Log was displayed incorrectly.
Fixed an issue where boss dialogue was not immediately triggered upon the death of a boss in multi-boss fights (2+ bosses).
Fixed an issue where the related achievement did not unlock even after fully maxing out the Two-handed Blunt Weapon skill tree.
Fixed an issue where hit effects were missing when hit by certain Elemental Attributes attacks.
Fixed an issue where players took no damage from certain monsters' fire explosion attacks.
